entries.305d6d823f470ee6: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,690 million (up 2.9% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥5,735 million (up 3.2%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥4,260 million (down 16.5%).
